foundations.name: Text

foundations.name: Link
foundations.notes: Hover: underline or brightness; use accent color.

foundations.name: Divider
foundations.notes: Horizontal: full width, 1px. Vertical: full height of parent, 1px.

actions.name: Button
actions.description: Primary action control. Token-driven color and size.

variants.name: solid
variants.notes: Slight vertical gradient OK; hover → color.accent.hover + shadow.md

actions.notes: Focus ring: 2px surface + 2px focus (color.focus @ ~55%). Disabled opacity 0.5. Hover lift −1px Y.

actions.name: ToggleGroup
actions.notes: Build as component set: Track frame + Toggle items. Active item elevated surface.

forms.name: Input
forms.notes: Focus: border mixes focus token; outer glow 3px focus@18%. Invalid: border color.danger.

forms.name: Textarea
forms.description: Multi-line text. Same chrome as Input, min-height ~96px.

forms.name: Select
forms.description: Native-styled select trigger (closed state in kit).
forms.notes: Include chevron icon right. Open state can show Menu/list panel below.

forms.name: Radio
forms.description: Radio control + label. Group radios on the kit page.

forms.name: Switch
forms.description: Toggle switch. Track 40×22.4, thumb slides when checked.

forms.name: Field
forms.notes: Compose from Label + Input instances in Figma.

forms.name: Combobox
forms.notes: Build closed trigger + open overlay as variants or separate components.

variants.name: glass

data-display.name: Skeleton
data-display.notes: Optional subtle shimmer; keep static in kit if preferred.
